research_question: How do money market accounts and CDs differ on rates, access, penalties and insurance?

research_brief.purpose: Compare the two with CFPB definitions and FDIC national averages and match each to a timeline.
research_brief.audience: Savers with short- to medium-term goals.
research_brief.data_period: FDIC national rates published October 19, 2026; CFPB and FDIC pages fetched November 7 to 9, 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Penalty amounts vary by institution and are not quoted. National averages are not quotes for any account.
